==Overview==
The '''AfreecaTV StarCraft League Remastered Season 13''' ('''ASL Season 13'''), is an offline tournament organized and broadcast live on [[AfreecaTV]].

<embedvideo service="youtube">https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ND1my7HUEcg</embedvideo>

==Tournament Information==
===Format===
* '''Round of 24 group stage'''
** [[Dual tournament]] format: {{abbr/Bo1}}
** Top two players in each group advance

* '''Round of 16 group stage'''
** 12 players from the Round of 24 join the four seeds from [[AfreecaTV StarCraft League Remastered/12|ASL Season 12]]
** [[Dual tournament]] format: First two matches: {{abbr/Bo1}} - Final three matches: {{abbr/Bo3}}
** Top two players in each group advance

* '''Elimination Stage'''
** Eight player single-elimination bracket
** Quarterfinals: {{abbr/Bo5}}
** Semi-Finals & Finals: {{abbr/Bo7}}
